title: Workload Motif Batcher Advisor: continuous profiling, heuristic scoring, safe apply/rollback
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: Build a batching recommendation engine that continuously profiles customer workloads to detect stable "motifs" (recurring request patterns), compute heuristic confidence scores for batching/cache changes, and apply configuration updates using a guarded, reversible pipeline. The advisor should produce ranked recommendations (batch_size, max_delay_ms, kv_cache_policy) with an explainable rationale and placement constraints by deployment type (hosted, dedicated, private). The feature must prioritize zero-regression to latency SLOs and response correctness while optimizing tokens-per-dollar.
acceptance_criteria: Collect per-customer workload fingerprints (sequence length distribution, kv reuse, arrival autocorrelation) with <2% added p99 latency overhead in production telemetry
Generate prioritized recommendations with a confidence score and estimated unit-cost savings for 80% of profiled workloads
Safe apply pipeline: shadow-apply -> canary by workload cohort -> monitored rollout with automated rollback triggers
Automated rollback triggers revert config within 5 minutes of breach and surface diagnostic artifacts to the console
Recommendation UI: show top 3 suggested profiles, expected cost delta, and a human-readable justification in Redwood Console
tasks: Design fingerprint schema and storage model (compact rolling sketches)
Implement lightweight sampler to collect motif signals at edge proxy (enable opt-in per org)
Develop heuristic scorer combining latency headroom, kv-hit opportunity, and token-cost delta
Integrate with config-management to stage shadow applies and execute canaries
Add telemetry dashboards and golden metrics (cost/unit, p50/p95 latency, generation error rate)
Build Console recommendation panel and integrate 'apply' flow with RBAC gates
rollout_plan: 1) Internal alpha: run advisor in shadow mode for 4 clusters; verify telemetry and false-positive rate. 2) Org beta: enable for 10 willing customers with no automatic apply (recommendations only). 3) Controlled autonomous apply: offer opt-in canary apply for non-critical workloads, limit to 5% traffic and schedule during low-traffic windows. 4) Full auto-rollout with throttling and safety budget once false-positive <1% and SLO breach rate <0.1% across beta orgs.
telemetry: canary_metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens_per_request, model_error_rate, customer_queries_per_minute
safe_apply_checks: no recent incident affecting the target org in last 7 days
RBAC approval required for orgs with dedicated SLA tier
rollback_triggers: p95 latency increases by >10% over baseline within 10 minutes
error rate (generation failures or malformed outputs) increases by >0.5% absolute
tokens_per_request rises unexpectedly by >15% indicating duplicated work
customer-specified manual rollback request via support-runbook
observed model output correctness degradation on eval prompt set (>2% drop in rubric score)
notes_and_links: Related infra tasks: ENG-741852 (shadow apply infra), ENG-314159 (cost synthesis prober)
